project.name: cronsmith-backend
project.description:
Aggregator for the cronsmith backend: the two Spring Boot starters (scheduler + executor) and their runnable reference applications. Build everything with:
mvn -f backend/pom.xml clean install -DskipTests
The base library `com.github.paganini2008:cronsmith` is NOT part of this repo (it is the upstream engine, released on its own); it is resolved from your local Maven repository, so run `mvn install` in the cronsmith repo once, or depend on the published artifact.
